methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-verified via WebFetch on 2026-06-19 for knock.app/pricing, novu.co/pricing, magicbell.com/pricing, suprsend.com/pricing, and engagespot.co/pricing; all returned 200 and corroborated the prices below. Compliance pages fetched: docs.knock.app/developer-tools/security (SOC 2 Type 2 + GDPR + HIPAA stated), novu.co/security (SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001 + GDPR + HIPAA stated), magicbell.com/security (GDPR explicitly stated; SOC 2 confirmed via secondary sources, NOT on /security; HIPAA absent). courier.com/pricing and the Courier blog returned HTTP 403 on every attempt; Courier plan data is secondary/indicative only and monthlyUsd is null for non-free tiers to avoid fabrication; Courier SOC 2 Type 2 is verifiable via its own live blog post (2022). 'starting from' prices (Novu Pro/Team) are noted as floors. Engagespot Enterprise 'starts from $2500 / custom volume' is treated as a contact-sales tier (monthlyUsd null, custom). All notification volumes are monthly; units differ by vendor (Novu = workflow runs, Engagespot = event triggers, MagicBell = per-channel deliveries). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

vendors.name: Knock
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified directly from knock.app/pricing on 2026-06-19 (Developer $0, Starter $250, Enterprise 'Contact us'). Compliance from docs.knock.app/developer-tools/security: 'Knock is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, GDPR certified, CCPA, and HIPAA compliant.' That page does NOT explicitly confirm a BAA (directs to security@knock.app), so baa set to null.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: 10,000 messages/month, 500 guide active users, 500 AI agent credits, unlimited workflows/broadcasts/channels/team members, batch and delay notifications, multi-tenancy, Google SSO. Overage on AI credits at $0.01/credit.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 50,000 messages/month ($0.005 per additional message), 2,500 guide active users ($0.05 each additional), 2,000 AI credits ($0.01 each additional). Includes everything in Developer plus Knock branding removal.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 'Contact us' on the pricing page. Flexible volume-based or monthly notified-user pricing with annual commit discounts. Adds per-customer branding, i18n, analytics/data warehouse integration, SCIM, SAML 2.0 SSO, HIPAA/BAA, enterprise SLAs, priority support.

limits: 500 guide active users on free tier
keyFeatures: Multi-tenant notification infrastructure with per-customer branding on Enterprise
In-app notification feed + guide banners/modals with pre-built UI components
Batch, delay, and digest workflows with visual builder
Preference management API with granular channel-level control
enrichment.provenance: Pricing confirmed directly from knock.app/pricing; integrations from docs.knock.app/integrations/overview; compliance from docs.knock.app/developer-tools/security (SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR, HIPAA; BAA not explicitly confirmed on page).

vendors.name: Courier
vendors.provenance: courier.com/pricing returned HTTP 403 on every direct fetch attempt on 2026-06-19, as did the Courier blog. Plan data is secondary/indicative only (G2, GetApp, dub.co, Courier blog excerpts via search); aggregators disagree on paid-tier prices ($19-$99/mo range cited), so monthlyUsd is null for paid tiers to avoid fabrication. SOC 2 Type 2 IS verifiable via Courier's own live blog post (courier.com/blog/how-courier-became-soc-2-type-2-compliant, 2022). HIPAA/GDPR not vendor-confirmed on an accessible page, so both null.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: ~10,000 notifications/month across all channels (corroborated by multiple secondary sources; official courier.com/pricing returns HTTP 403 and could not be vendor-verified). Indicative.

plans.name: Pro (usage-based)
plans.notes: Usage-based pay-per-notification model above the free tier. Exact per-notification rate could NOT be vendor-confirmed (official page 403; secondary sources conflict on both monthly entry price and per-message rate), so all price fields are null. Removed the unverifiable '~$0.005/notification' figure that appeared in the draft.
